user_stories.title: Assemble Full Causal LOB Forecaster Model with Explicit Masking
user_stories.description: Combine Siamese network, feature fusion, DAIN, and T-KAN head into single PyTorch model with explicit causal masking in attention mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: Model takes bid_data, ask_data, and macro_data as inputs.
Outputs multi-step forecasts with correct dimensions.
Explicit causal_mask parameter added to attention layers.
Model passes causality test: output unchanged when future inputs are perturbed.
user_stories.verification: python -c "import sys; import torch; sys.path.insert(0, 'src/models'); from causal_lob_forecaster import CausalLOBForecaster; model = CausalLOBForecaster(bid_ask_dim=5, macro_dim=8, hidden_dims=[32, 64], horizon=5); bid = torch.randn(2, 20, 5); ask = torch.randn(2, 20, 5); macro = torch.randn(2, 20, 8); out1 = model(bid, ask, macro); bid[:, 10:, :] = torch.randn_like(bid[:, 10:, :]); out2 = model(bid, ask, macro); assert torch.allclose(out1[:, :10, :], out2[:, :10, :]), 'Causality violated!'; print('Causality test passed')"

user_stories.title: Create Comprehensive Causality Tests
user_stories.description: Write pytest tests verifying causality property through forward/backward pass analysis and gradient flow inspection.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover: 1) Future perturbation invariance 2) Gradient causality 3) Training step isolation.

user_stories.title: Implement Causal Attention Masking in T-KAN Head
user_stories.description: Modify existing T-KAN implementation to include explicit causal masking preventing information flow from future to past.
acceptance_criteria: T-KAN attention layers include triangular causal mask.
Mask is applied during both training and inference.
user_stories.verification: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src/models'); from t_kan_heads import T_KANHead; head = T_KANHead(input_dim=64, horizon=5, causal_mask=True); test_input = torch.randn(2, 20, 64); output = head(test_input); print('Causal T-KAN head operational'); assert output.shape == (2, 5, 1)"
